codepilot.config.serverPath: Path to the system `codepilot` CLI (fallback when the bundled engine is missing).
codepilot.config.cliPath: Optional path to a CodePilot CLI entry. When empty, uses the bundled engine, then serverPath.
codepilot.config.nodePath: Path to the node executable used to launch the bundled / cliPath engine.
codepilot.config.engineMode: shared (default): attach to or spawn a local daemon over WebSocket. stdio: private legacy process (debug).
codepilot.config.permissionMode: Default permission mode for new sessions. Synced to ~/.codepilot/config.json.
codepilot.config.model: Default model id (e.g. claude-sonnet-4.5). Synced to ~/.codepilot/config.json. Use “CodePilot: Set API Key” for secrets.
codepilot.config.systemPromptExtra: Extra system prompt text appended to every new session.
codepilot.config.autoApprove: Tool names or bash command regexes that auto-approve.
codepilot.config.showDiff: When true, edit_file/write_file tool calls open a vscode.diff tab.
codepilot.config.agentMode: Default collaboration mode for new sessions (Ask / Plan / Agent). Synced to ~/.codepilot/config.json.
codepilot.config.completion.enabled: Enable inline (Tab) code completion. Requires a lightweight smallModel distinct from chat.
codepilot.config.completion.debounceMs: Milliseconds to wait after you stop typing before requesting an inline completion.
codepilot.config.completion.maxTokens: Soft cap on inline completion length (tokens).
